# Patient RX System v3.0.4

## Call Center and Patient Eligibility Alignment

This patch makes the Call Center queue, Call Center metrics, Dashboard eligibility, and Patients eligibility filter use the same configured service-window value and active-patient population.

## What Changed

- Removed the remaining fixed 91-day Call Center eligible-since offset.
- Call Center queue and metrics APIs now return the configured window and exact server eligibility cutoff.
- The Call Center screen displays the configured window.
- New Service Date fields use the server-provided cutoff.
- Patients eligibility categories now include active patients only, matching Dashboard and Call Center totals even when the Status filter is set to `All`.
- Added regression checks for Call Center configurable-window wiring and active-patient eligibility alignment.

## Data Impact

- No database migration or data reset is required.
- Existing service-window settings, patients, RX records, and history are preserved.

## Deployment

1. Back up the production database and application folder.
2. Stop the RX application service.
3. Deploy `server-update-3.0.4.zip`, preserving the production `.env`.
4. Start the service and verify the administrator version endpoint reports `3.0.4`.
5. Refresh or reopen Patients and Call Center pages.
6. Confirm Patients > Eligible Now and Call Center > Eligible Now use the same configured window and active-patient population.
